procedures.name: InitOutstandingQty
procedures.doc: Initializes outstanding quantity and base quantity for the current transfer line.

procedures.name: InitQtyToShip
procedures.doc: Initializes quantity to ship fields for the current transfer line.

procedures.name: InitQtyToReceive
procedures.doc: Initializes quantity to receive based on in transit location for the current transfer line.

procedures.name: InitQtyInTransit
procedures.doc: Calculates the quantity in transit based on in transit location for the current transfer line. Verifies whether the transfer line is completely received by checking if the Quantity is not zero and if it is equal to the "Quantity Received".

procedures.name: ResetPostedQty
procedures.doc: Resets the posted quantities for the current transfer line.

procedures.name: GetTransHeaderExternal
procedures.doc: Retrieves the transfer header information and assigns it to the corresponding fields in the current transfer line.

procedures.name: BlockDynamicTracking
procedures.doc: Sets the block status for dynamic tracking of the transfer line.

procedures.name: ShowDimensions
procedures.doc: Opens a page that shows the dimensions of the current transfer line.

procedures.name: CreateDim
procedures.doc: Generates a new dimension set id from provided default dimensions for the current transfer line.

procedures.name: ValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Triggers validation of shortcut dimension values.

procedures.name: LookupShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Displays a shortcut dimension list for the user to choose from.

procedures.name: ShowShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Retrieves a shortcut dimension list for the current transfer line.

procedures.name: SelectMultipleItems
procedures.doc: Runs an item list page for the user to select multiple items for transfer.

procedures.name: AddItems
procedures.doc: Adds items to the transfer line based on the specified selection filter.

procedures.name: AddItem
procedures.doc: Creates a new transfer line and validates item no based on provided 'ItemNo'.

procedures.name: InitNewLine
procedures.doc: Initializes a new transfer line based on the current record.

procedures.name: CheckItemAvailable
procedures.doc: Checks if an item is available for transfer.

procedures.name: CheckDirectTransferQtyToShip
procedures.doc: Checks if the entire quantity on the line is shipped in case of direct Transfer.

procedures.name: OpenItemTrackingLines
procedures.doc: Opens the item tracking lines for the specified transfer direction.

procedures.name: OpenItemTrackingLinesWithReclass
procedures.doc: Opens the item tracking lines for the specified transfer direction.

procedures.name: TestStatusOpen
procedures.doc: Test whether the status of a transfer document is set to 'Open'.

procedures.name: SuspendStatusCheck
procedures.doc: Sets the status check suspension flag.

procedures.name: ShowReservation
procedures.doc: Displays the reservation for the transfer line.

procedures.name: UpdateWithWarehouseShipReceive
procedures.doc: Updates "Qty. to Ship" and "Qty. to Receive" fields of current transfer line based on location setup.

procedures.name: RenameNo
procedures.doc: Renames the item number in the transfer line table.

procedures.name: CheckWarehouse
procedures.doc: Checks warehouse requirements for a transfer line. It determines whether a dialog should be displayed to the user based on the location setup and receive flag. In case a dialog needs to be displayed, an appropriate message or error is presented.

procedures.name: GetRemainingQty
procedures.doc: Calculates remaining quantity and remaining base quantity according to specified direction for the current transfer line.

procedures.name: GetReservationQty
procedures.doc: Retrieves reservation quantities for the current transfer line.

procedures.name: GetSourceCaption
procedures.doc: Combines values of "Document No.", "Line No." and "Item No." fields of the current transfer line.

procedures.name: SetReservationEntry
procedures.doc: Sets the reservation entry for the current transfer line based on specified direction.

procedures.name: SetReservationFilters
procedures.doc: Sets filters for the specified reservation entry based on the transfer direction.

procedures.name: ReservEntryExist
procedures.doc: Checks if a reservation entry exists for the transfer line.

procedures.name: IsInbound
procedures.doc: Checks if the current transfer line is inbound.

procedures.name: FilterLinesWithItemToPlan
procedures.doc: Filters the lines with the provided item for planning.

procedures.name: FindLinesWithItemToPlan
procedures.doc: Finds the lines with the provided item to plan.

procedures.name: LinesWithItemToPlanExist
procedures.doc: Checks if there are any lines with the provided item that need to be planned.

procedures.name: FilterInboundLinesForReservation
procedures.doc: Filters the inbound transfer lines based on provided reservation entry and availability date filter.

procedures.name: FilterOutboundLinesForReservation
procedures.doc: Filters the outbound transfer lines based on provided reservation entry and availability date filter.

procedures.name: VerifyItemLineDim
procedures.doc: Verifies if the item line dimensions have been changed and confirms the change if necessary.

procedures.name: ReserveFromInventory
procedures.doc: Automatically creates reservations for the item quantity of provided transfer lines.

procedures.name: IsShippedDimChanged
procedures.doc: Determines if the dimensions of already shipped transfer line have been changed.

procedures.name: ConfirmShippedDimChange
procedures.doc: Confirms the change of dimensions for an already shipped transfer line.

procedures.name: GetTransferHeader
procedures.doc: Retrieves the transfer header record based on document number of the current transfer line.

procedures.name: DateConflictCheck
procedures.doc: Checks for date conflicts in the transfer line in case global parameter 'TrackingBlocked' is set to false.

procedures.name: RowID1
procedures.doc: Returns the Row ID for the specified transfer direction.

procedures.name: CreateDimFromDefaultDim
procedures.doc: Creates a dimension based on default dimension source.

procedures.name: CheckIfTransferLineMeetsReservedFromStockSetting
procedures.doc: Checks if qunatity on the current transfer line meets the reserved from stock setting.

procedures.name: ShowReservationEntries
procedures.doc: Displays reservation entries for the current transfer line.

procedures.name: RecreateServLines
procedures.doc: Recalculates existing service lines related to current service header based on new values from hader.

procedures.name: UpdateServLinesByFieldNo
procedures.doc: Propagates changes for specific fields provided by 'ChangedFieldNo' to service lines related to current service header.

procedures.name: TestMandatoryFields
procedures.doc: Verify if all necessary fields are populated for provided service lines based on service management setup.

procedures.name: UpdateResponseDateTime
procedures.doc: Updates values of 'Response Date' and 'Response Time' based on related service item line.

procedures.name: ServItemLineExists
procedures.doc: Checks if service item line exists for current service header record.

procedures.name: ServLineExists
procedures.doc: Checks if service line exists for current service header record.

procedures.name: SetHideValidationDialog
procedures.doc: Sets value to the global 'HideValidationDialog' which indicates if messages or confirmation dialogs should be shown.

procedures.name: SetValidatingFromLines
procedures.doc: Indicates if of values 'Sarting Date', 'Starting Time', 'Finishing Date' and 'Finishing Time' will be taken from related service item line for current service header. Also it controls if field 'Fault Reason Code' should be populated on related service item lines.

procedures.name: TestNoSeries
procedures.doc: Test if a setup for services number series is defined in the service management setup record, also if a corresponding general journal template setup exist.

procedures.name: GetNoSeriesCode
procedures.doc: Gets a number series code for the current service header record based on 'Document Type'.

procedures.name: UpdateServiceOrderChangeLog
procedures.doc: Updates service order change log based on changes done to the current service header record.

procedures.name: InitInsert
procedures.doc: Initialize values for the new service header record.

procedures.name: InitRecord
procedures.doc: Initialize values for the new service header record.

procedures.name: SetShipToAddress
procedures.doc: Sets shipment information from provided parameters for the current service header record.

procedures.name: ConfirmDeletion
procedures.doc: Runs confirmation dialog to confirm deletion of related service document record.

procedures.name: ShowDocDim
procedures.doc: Depicts document dimensions for overview. If changes are made, they will be saved to the current record.

procedures.name: SetShipToCustomerAddressFieldsFromShipToAddr
procedures.doc: Sets 'Ship-to' address information from 'ShipToAddr'.

procedures.name: CopyCustomerFields
procedures.doc: Transfers relevant field values from provided customer to the current service header record.

procedures.name: GetFullDocTypeTxt
procedures.doc: Gets document type for current service header record.

procedures.name: GetServiceMgtSetup
procedures.doc: Gets the value for the global variable 'ServiceMgtSetup'.

procedures.name: IsCreditDocType
procedures.doc: Checks if the current service header field 'Type' value is 'Credit Memo'.

procedures.name: CopyToGenJournalLine
procedures.doc: Transfers relevant field values from current service header to the provided general journal line.

procedures.name: CopyToGenJournalLineApplyTo
procedures.doc: Transfers apply-to document information from current service header to the provided general journal line.

procedures.name: CopyToGenJournalLinePayment
procedures.doc: Transfers payment information from current service header to the provided general journal line.

procedures.name: CopyToItemJnlLine
procedures.doc: Transfers relevant field values from current service header to the provided item journal line.

procedures.name: GetLatestStateRecord
procedures.doc: Retrieves the latest deployment state record. Returns false if none exists.

procedures.name: GetLatestCompletedState
procedures.doc: Retrieves the latest completed deployment state record. Returns an empty record if there's none

procedures.name: GetUploadStatus
procedures.doc: Derives the current upload status from the latest Power BI Deployment State record. This is the single source of truth for deployment status.

procedures.name: FailCurrentStep
procedures.doc: Marks the latest state record as failed with the given reason. If no state record exists yet (e.g. the very first step failed before any transition), creates one with Status Reached = NotStarted so the failure is never silently lost.

procedures.name: ResetDeployment
procedures.doc: Resets a deployment by deleting all state records. After this, GetUploadStatus() returns NotStarted and the aggregator will include the report as pending work for re-deployment. Used both for retrying failed deployments and for applying version updates.

procedures.name: DeleteAllRecords
procedures.doc: Wipes all local deployment tracking data for the current company across every deployable report. Reports already uploaded to the Power BI workspace are not touched.

procedures.name: DeleteAllRecords
procedures.doc: Wipes all local deployment tracking data in the specified company. Used by subscribers that need to clear records in a different company than the caller's (e.g. after Copy Company, where the subscriber runs in the source company but must wipe the target).

procedures.name: RecordStep
procedures.doc: Creates a new state record for the given status.
